name: single-leg-jump-rope
instructions:
1. Grasp a jump rope with the handles at your sides and the rope behind your heels.
2. Rotate the wrists to generate velocity and help the rope revolve around the body.
3. As the rope moves toward your feet, hop with one leg to allow it to pass underneath.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or time.
